description: This file contains implementation of functions related to engine trigger decoders, including calculation of engine cycle based on operation mode, addition of trigger events for skipped teeth, and configuration of different trigger shapes for engine synchronization.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: A class representing the shape of a trigger wheel, with methods to add events and initialize shape parameters.

methods.name: angle_t getEngineCycle(operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Calculates the engine cycle in degrees based on the operation mode (two-stroke or four-stroke).

methods.name: void addSkippedToothTriggerEvents(trigger_wheel_e wheel,TriggerShape * s,int totalTeethCount,int skippedCount,float toothWidth,float offset,float engineCycle,float filterLeft,float filterRight)
methods.description: Adds trigger events to simulate a trigger wheel with skipped teeth, based on total teeth count and skipped teeth.

methods.name: void initializeSkippedToothTriggerShapeExt(TriggerShape * s,int totalTeethCount,int skippedCount,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with skipped teeth, setting synchronization parameters and validation.

methods.name: void configureOnePlusOne(TriggerShape * s,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for a specific engine trigger pattern with primary and secondary events.

methods.name: void configureOnePlus60_2(TriggerShape * s,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for an engine with 60 teeth and 2 skipped teeth, with specific timing for trigger events.

methods.name: void configure3_1_cam(TriggerShape * s,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for a three-gear cam sensor pattern with multiple trigger points.

ctags.name: addSkippedToothTriggerEvents
ctags.signature: (trigger_wheel_e wheel,TriggerShape * s,int totalTeethCount,int skippedCount,float toothWidth,float offset,float engineCycle,float filterLeft,float filterRight)
